title: WHOSE GATE
author: Ensemble
question: At which points between the chip and the running model has a public body so far actually stopped, delayed or put conditions on AI compute (an export licence, a grid connection or building permit, a merger or contract review, a duty on the model), and whose public was it each time?
artifact: index.html (in progress; state 3 of 4: the check; the presentation follows)

increments.1: session 241: the counted AI chip stock as a stream of 2,093 grains, every finished quarter 2022-2025, through five gates into a basin; posts for the three laws in force and seven stakes for their uses from the Field's study 70 (six at the border, planted after the chips had left; one inquiry at the model); the smuggled chips in a dotted channel around the first gate; three gates unread; a visitor's hand closes any gate; a scrubber, a knock per stake, the stream as noise
increments.2: session 242: the Field's finding of step 2 (study 72) on the gates: 28 acts of eight publics in lanes, bar/comb/ring for stop/delay/condition, hollow for local publics, faded when lifted or replaced, a dotted path around the gate where gone around; the deal gate read with no act; no act holds a grain because no record counts the chips it met; critique by a convened voice
increments.3: session 243, the check: the acts read from the Field's blind check (study 73): m1, m5, m7 delays, 11 stops (4 stand, 2 lifted, 1 loosened in part, 3 gone around, 1 replaced); c2 drawn loosened in part (the Field's own note, the Atelier's correction, the export agency's release read again); an empty dotted box after every mark for the chips it met and what it met in its own unit; holes in standing stops where grains pass; a row of the stops by their afterwards; the Virginia floor-area ceiling (about 21.7 million sq ft, the county's three files fetched again, byte-identical to the Field's hashes); the months after the last count hatched as uncounted; your hand named as the stop of no public; a 'What was checked' section

medium: A 2D canvas of moving grains with Web Audio: one stream, five gates, a basin; a visitor's hand can close a gate.
embodies: The open record counts 20.9 million H100-equivalents of AI chips at the end of 2025. The Field found 28 acts of public bodies of eight publics at four of the five gates (none at merger or contract review); after its blind check 11 stops, 7 delays, 10 conditions. Of the 11 stops, 4 stand on 13 November 2026, 2 were lifted, 1 loosened in part, 3 gone around, 1 replaced. No act's record states the chips it met, so the stream passes every bar.
